_comment: Everything the release script knows about the mods. The Wrench Works rename is an edit to this file only: ids, zip names, folders and info paths.

info.name: wrench_complete
info.title: Wrench Complete
info.tagline: The complete West Coast USA street racing career, garage and drivers in one mod
info.description: Everything in one mod: a hands-on garage with a working lift, a street racing career from a junkyard wreck to the top of the ROC, drivers in every car with injuries in crashes, and rain, dirt and scratches on the car body. All settings are in ESC > Mods. Plays on West Coast USA. Remove the separate Wrench Works, Street Legal, Drivers and Car Surface FX mods before installing this one.
info.author: Connor Moyle

mods.title: Wrench Works: Garage
mods._why_exclude: the original game's sounds and music are not ours to hand out (same rule as tools/package.ps1)

mods.title: Wrench Works: Career
mods._why_exclude: SLRR's own art is copied from each player's install by tools/slrr_ui.py, never shipped

mods.title: Car Surface FX
mods._why: works standalone (rain, dirt and scratches on any car); Street Legal and the garage use it when it is installed (sl_surfacefx), nothing needs it

bundles.title: Wrench Works Street Legal - West Coast
bundles._why: One download for the West Coast USA career: the garage, the career (the part pictures are in its art folder) Drivers & Pedestrians and Car Surface FX (rain, dirt and scratches on the cars; optional, nothing needs it). No Valo City map. Each mod keeps its own version and requires; the versions are listed in bundle.json.

bundles.title: Wrench Works Street Legal - West Coast (without Car Surface FX)
bundles._why: The same download without Car Surface FX (not published yet): the garage, the career, Drivers & Pedestrians and Driver Injuries.
